text: {"lessons":["My account has risen overall, but that alone does not show which choices helped; I should review my holdings and risks rather than assume recent gains will continue.","Selling some of Stocks A and D after substantial gains reduced my exposure, but I should not treat their past returns as a reason by themselves to sell or buy.","Because my retirement savings need to support living expenses and I want to avoid large swings, I should favor a measured, diversified approach and avoid frequent trading."]}
